name: magpie
title: Magpie
description: Front end for magpie, the local app that assigns each coding agent a model. Switch models, apply profiles, and view usage and quota.
author: dengpeng

commands.name: switch-model
commands.title: Switch Agent Model
commands.description: List installed agents and switch the model each one uses

commands.name: profiles
commands.title: Use Profile
commands.description: List saved magpie profiles and apply one

commands.name: usage
commands.title: Show Usage
commands.description: Show magpie token usage by agent and model

commands.name: subscriptions
commands.title: Show Subscription Quotas
commands.description: Show subscription allowance and reset times known to magpie

preferences.name: binaryPath
preferences.title: Magpie CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the magpie executable. ~, $HOME, and ${HOME} are expanded. The path is not passed through a shell.
